validation.rootTestsNote: Isolated host-root run: DSH_CONTROLS_HOST_ROOT plus the checksum-bound accepted tarball, so no environment-gated host integration case was skipped. A plain node --test without that host seam reports 765 cases with 286 environment-gated skips.
validation.featureEvidence: Dynamic profiling of a live process measured the plugin at 64% of CPU: a single call site, liveSessionFacts, deep-froze the whole live owner event array on every authorization/hook call (47,223 events and about 366,827 objects, 135.2 ms per call, 7-8.4 calls per second in the sampled process). Owner headers are classified from the header alone, so owner sessions now carry no events, subagent facts are materialized once and reused for a short window, and documents returned by storage adapters are parsed once per returned value instead of once per read.
validation.privacy: Only six closed assets published; no local raw logs, profile snapshots or session evidence

review.independentReview: dynamic profiling performed by a delegated investigator against the running process; no independent code review of this release
